conbody.p: The Refresh Clauses functionality allows you to keep your contract template up to date. If the contract template contains clauses, and one clause has been changed but not published, this functionality can update the clause in the contract template in context. The clauses having any of the following changes will appear in the Refresh Clauses list:

ul.li: Addition, deletion, or modification in clause content
Change in the smart, read-only or merge fields
